integrity_statement: Proof, estimator domain, exact formulas, reproducible symbolic checks and limitations are provided. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-orientation threshold is two-dimensional; higher-dimensional persistence is only for sufficiently small positive diagonal tails.
Mixed Gaussian sketch and Rademacher correction differs from the all-Gaussian published Nyström++ implementation.
Compares two prescribed stochastic two-product designs, not arbitrary optimal two-product estimators; coordinate-basis queries are exact in dimension two.
Independent priority verification and independent scientific audit are outstanding.
title: A sharp spectrum-and-orientation crossover for two-query Nyström trace estimation
